reviews.comment: He is not the worst professor ever, but if you are taking this course, definitely take another professor. His lectures are really hard to follow and make the material way more complicated than needed. You will spend a lot of time having to learn the material yourself. He does give some grace with extra credit points and cheat sheets on every exam.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Mr. Xeno is my favorite professor ever! My first exam and quiz were decent, but with the extra credit points I was able to raise my grade by a lot more and get an A! I feel like a lot of the negative reviews are from people that aren't taking advantage of this, so just make sure to attend and learn and you'll surely get an A!

Do not take this professor unless you want to learn the whole course yourself. His lectures are very unorganized and hard to understand and his handwriting is messy. The slides are incorrect. Just makes it even more confusing if you go to class. He also scheduled a quiz for the evening before Thanksgiving break and didn't even come.

Take any other professor! He is the only prof who has on paper exams, every other prof gives their exams on excel. He scheduled a quiz for the Tuesday before Thanksgiving and didn't even show up! Took the quiz with a TA. His slides are gibberish, lectures are boring/irrelevant, and you will end up teaching yourself everything.

His lectures are chaotic and the slides are often wrong—he just says “pretend it says this” and never fixes them on Canvas. Stats isn't a hard class, but he makes it harder than it needs to be. Easily the worst stats professor in Mays. Other profs offer 80+ extra credit, my friends have A+ in other classes.  He gave 10 points, doesn't help much.

Class is overstimulating. He has a very thick accent, and his teaching style is chaotic and hard to follow. When the class will not yell out the answer to a question, he repeats it over and over. Overall, not a difficult class, but his teaching style makes the content seem much more confusing than it is. If you can take another professor, do so.
Best teacher i have ever had. Wow just amazing funny lectures. That is how a lecture is suppose to be fun and a treasure of knowledge.

Lets students have a cheat sheet on the test so you don't have to memorize a lot. Do the additional problems he offers because they are identical to the quiz and exam questions. Offers LOTS of extra credit. Sometimes, attendance is extra credit. Kahoot at end of class. Caring and understanding! Can do well in class without attending lectures.

Xen is super caring about his students and gives tons of opportunities for bonus points. The tests are very similar to the practice questions he gives in class and on canvas, and the lowest quiz grade is dropped. Showing up to class is crucial because he explains concepts really well and sometimes gives bonus points for just attending class.

If you understood statistics in high school, this class is an easy A. I never paid attention to any lecture and would get an A on the tests. He allows a one-page cheat sheet aswell. Go to class because the random extra credit will boost your grade tremendously. The third test is the hardest. He shares a little too much about his personal life.

Xen is a funny guy, he does magic in class, and gives a lot of extra credit based on kahoot placement. Attendance is not mandatory but sometimes he gives extra credit randomly. Tests were easy in my opinion and you can guess lots of problems with common sense. However, definitely study for them because exams are around 85% of your grade.

Don't skip lectures, gives so much extra credit, likes magic, funny and inspirational, probably my favorite professor that I have had at Mays. No homework, just make sure to practice a bunch for exams and quizzes because you are not graded on much. The goat!!!

Xen is not the worst professor i've had. His class is super test heavy with 600/700 points being from the tests and 60 being quizzes and the other 40 are 2 small assignments. I am not great at exams so thats why I struggled but overall his teaching is quite fine. He gives out lots of extra credit. Make sure to do the practice problems.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof. Xen is by far the best teacher I have ever had. He is extremely nice and cares a lot about his students- he wants everyone to succeed! He gives a lot of extra credit so just show up to class and participate. He also holds review sessions before tests that help a lot. He does a ton of examples and tests are similar to his practice! Take him!!

Professor Xen makes a boring class interesting enough to not fall asleep. Stats is incredibly easy and my group of friends will all be finishing with above a 100 in the class. The previous negative reviews are people who weren't smart enough to succeed in these easy classes.

Xen was overall a great professor, His class is very test heavy with 600/700 points being from exams so if you aren't an exam person (me) then it will be challenging but not impossible. His class has only 2 homework assignments throughout the entire semester with an emphasis on coming to class to learn and understand the material.

I took BUSN STATS with proff. Xeno. Honestly, his teaching style is mediocre. He doesn't really like to talk to you if you are a man, only interested in speaking to the girls. He does magic tricks, again kinda mediocre. He always talks about his dates and who women ghost, it's really weird. Makes a lot of alcohol jokes.  Take another professor tbh.

One of the most #amaysing professors at the mays business school. Professor Xen is engaging with all of his classes and even if the content is a lot, he gives a lot of extra credit opportunities. Also, he's got office hours if you want an update on your current grade.
SCMT 334. Good professor overall. Do all the extra credit you can and study and you'll get an A. There is a lot to learn and the material can be somewhat boring.

SCMT334: Professor Xen doesn't just stand and teach like a robot. He will incorporate real life scenarios, jokes, and extra credits into his lectures that makes this class so enjoyable. Don't be mislead by the previous negative reviews. There are 3 exams and group case study. Study but also have fun.

Took his 334 class this past semester. Only grades were 3 tests and a case study. First two tests were not bad, he gives a good study guide that has test questions on them. Biggest thing about this course was the case study. You are only given 3 weeks to do it. Offers tons of extra credit for attending events, boosted my grade from an C to an A
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Group projects

reviews.comment: I do not recommend this professor. On multiple occasions when I have asked questions for clarification, he has rolled his eyes at me. He acts like everyone taking his class is pursuing a career in purchasing, not to mention he brings up spouses and marriage too often. His tests are too detail heavy and the case study is ridiculously long.

There is nothing more that I cannot stand than an arrogant professor. Xen acts like his entire existence is to make sure you know you are missing opportunities when real life steps in the way of his. Tests are extremely difficult, unless you are the kind of student that doesn't have to have a job and can spend the entirety of your day studying it.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The tests are easy, just basic statistical concepts but his lectures are convoulted and seems more complicated than they need to be. Still a solid choice for SCMT 303
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Alright, professor, however, doesn't explain much and if you go to his office hours he will make fun of you. First two exams were 40 questions each and were relatively easy, however, the final was 80 questions and unnecessarily hard. Gives a lot of extra credit so do them all

The first two tests were around 40 questions and you're given two hours which is plenty of time. Then on the final he doubled the amount of questions and you barely had time to do half of them. I went from having an A to a B because of that test. I highly encourage you to do all extra credit and do the practice problems he gives you. Dont use book!

Prof Koufteros was a really entertaining professor. He loves magic tricks and getting to know each and every student. He gives a ton of extra credit, so if you are struggling, you are able to make pretty much any grade you want. Quizzes and exams are not too hard, but you're going to want to do the practice problems before hand. Easy A if you try.

3 exams. 1st one is easy and you should get a really nice boost. 2nd is more difficult. 3rd one is tough. Posts lecture slides. I never understood most of his lectures in the harder part of the class. Definitely respected and extremely friendly. Even got us pizza once. He wants you to pass and gives you the resources. Pretty tough class though
Best professor at A&M. Not only when you take his class, but also when looking for jobs, etc. Such a caring and awesome guy
Dr. Koufteros is my favorite professor I have had. He gives lots of bonus opportunities, and he even does his own quiz and test review sessions. Also, very cool guy
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: The best professor I have had at Texas A&M University. Easily accessible after class, even after the end of semester. Very helpful, not only on course material, but with your resume and job search. His lectures are filled with all real life examples he gathered based on his experience and are really helpful.

Great professor! As long as you attend class, the exams are pretty straight forward but they do include a few essay questions so be prepared! Very willing to help his students. He will even help you out with your resume!
